description: This file is a build script for a media framework component, written in Bash. It defines functions for configuring, cleaning, building, rebuilding, and installing a software component, and manages environment variables and command-line options for the build process.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information about script usage and supported actions.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Runs autoreconf and configures the build environment based on platform and options.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes build artifacts and resets the build directory.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Compiles the source code using make.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Performs a clean, configure, and build sequence.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the built components and copies necessary scripts and properties to designated directories.
